- Credit 5950 for 4018.13. This zeroes out the invalid account.
- Debit 5500 for 4018.13. This moves the expense to Travel.

No invoice status changes, because this is not a duplicate_invoice finding. The account codes are written without padding, since the ledger's CHAR(8) column pads them automatically.
